description: This file defines the SynthEngine class, which is a polyphonic, single-channel MIDI synthesizer implemented in Java for Android. It handles MIDI event processing, manages synthesizer voices, and produces audio output in a background thread.

classes.name: SynthEngine
classes.description: Main class managing MIDI synthesis, including MIDI event handling, voice management, and audio output in Android.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: Inner class extending MidiReceiver to handle incoming MIDI messages, converting them into internal method calls.

classes.name: MyRunnable
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to run the synthesis process in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: SynthEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing with default or provided audio output.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver.onSend to pass MIDI events to the event scheduler unless it's an active sensing message.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Turns off a note with given channel, note index, and velocity.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Turns on a note with specific parameters, creating or reusing a SynthVoice.

methods.name: createVoice
methods.description: Creates a new SynthVoice instance based on the program number.

methods.name: pitchBend
methods.description: Adjusts pitch bend for all active voices based on bend value.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the audio synthesis thread and initializes MIDI event scheduler.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the synthesis thread and releases resources.

methods.name: onLoopStarted
methods.description: Hook for actions before the synthesis loop begins.

methods.name: onBufferCompleted
methods.description: Hook for actions after each synthesis buffer is generated.

methods.name: onLoopEnded
methods.description: Hook for cleanup after the synthesis loop ends.

methods.name: logMidiMessage
methods.description: Logs MIDI messages received for debugging.

methods.name: processMidiEvents
methods.description: Handles scheduled MIDI events, sending them into the MIDI framer.

methods.name: generateBuffer
methods.description: Synthesizes audio data by mixing all active voices into the buffer.
